title: Google Dorking & Search Reconnaissance Quick Reference

rows.label: site:
rows.value: Limit to one domain. site:target.com — shows all indexed pages. The result count indicates the size of the indexed footprint.

rows.label: filetype:
rows.value: Find specific file types. site:target.com filetype:pdf | filetype:xlsx | filetype:docx | filetype:env | filetype:sql | filetype:conf

rows.label: intitle:
rows.value: Match page title. intitle:"index of" → directory listings. intitle:"index of" site:target.com → open directories on target.

rows.label: inurl:
rows.value: Match URL content. inurl:admin | inurl:login | inurl:portal | inurl:phpmyadmin | inurl:wp-admin | inurl:manager

rows.label: intext:
rows.value: Match body content. intext:"confidential" | intext:"internal use only" | intext:"BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY" | intext:password

rows.label: cache:
rows.value: Google's last saved copy. cache:target.com/page — shows content as Google last crawled it. Useful for deleted pages (where still available).

rows.label: "exact phrase"
rows.value: Require exact match. "target company name" filetype:xlsx — finds spreadsheets mentioning the target anywhere on the web.

rows.label: - (minus)
rows.value: Exclude term. site:target.com -www — focuses on subdomains other than www.

rows.label: Sensitive documents
rows.value: site:target.com filetype:pdf intitle:confidential | site:target.com filetype:xlsx | site:target.com filetype:docx "internal use only"

rows.label: Open directories
rows.value: site:target.com intitle:"index of" | site:target.com intitle:"index of" inurl:backup | site:target.com intitle:"index of" inurl:upload

rows.label: Login portals
rows.value: site:target.com inurl:admin | site:target.com inurl:login | site:target.com inurl:wp-admin | site:target.com inurl:phpmyadmin

rows.label: Configuration files
rows.value: site:target.com filetype:env | site:target.com filetype:conf | site:target.com filetype:cfg | site:target.com filetype:log

rows.label: GitHub credential leaks
rows.value: site:github.com "target.com" password | site:github.com "target company" api_key OR secret OR token

rows.label: Pastebin mentions
rows.value: site:pastebin.com "target company name"

rows.label: robots.txt location
rows.value: Always at root: target.com/robots.txt — Read it first on every engagement. Lists paths the organisation considers sensitive as Disallow directives.

rows.label: What robots.txt does
rows.value: Requests cooperative crawlers skip listed paths. Does NOT restrict access. Does NOT prevent non-cooperative crawlers. Listed paths are directly accessible.

rows.label: sitemap.xml location
rows.value: Usually at target.com/sitemap.xml (or referenced in robots.txt Sitemap: directive) — Complete list of intended public URLs. Baseline for identifying unintended exposures.

rows.label: Professional action
rows.value: Download both files. Every robots.txt Disallow path gets visited directly. Every URL in sitemap.xml is the intended footprint — URLs found elsewhere are unintended.

rows.label: Bing
rows.value: Supports site:, filetype:, intitle:, inurl: — run same dorks. Different index = different results. May contain content Google deindexed.

rows.label: web.archive.org
rows.value: Wayback Machine — historical page snapshots. Enter any domain. Check robots.txt history, old page versions, deleted content, former subdomains.

rows.label: Shodan (shodan.io)
rows.value: Search engine for internet-connected devices. org:"Target Name", ssl:"target.com" — reveals open ports, software versions, SSL certificates. Use in authorised engagements.

rows.label: GitHub / GitLab
rows.value: site:github.com "target.com" — finds public repositories referencing the target. Use TruffleHog or Gitleaks for credential scanning of repositories.

rows.label: Step 1
rows.value: site:target.com — understand indexed footprint size and content categories

rows.label: Step 2
rows.value: target.com/robots.txt — read all Disallow paths; visit each one directly

rows.label: Step 3
rows.value: target.com/sitemap.xml — establish intended public URL baseline

rows.label: Step 4
rows.value: site:target.com filetype:pdf | xlsx | docx | env | sql — find indexed documents

rows.label: Step 5
rows.value: site:target.com intitle:"index of" — find open directory listings

rows.label: Step 6
rows.value: site:target.com inurl:admin | login | portal | phpmyadmin — find login portals

rows.label: Step 7
rows.value: site:github.com + site:pastebin.com — check external platforms for leaks

rows.label: Step 8
rows.value: web.archive.org — check historical snapshots for deleted content and old infrastructure

rows.label: Step 9
rows.value: Extract metadata from any discovered documents: exiftool document.pdf
